verdict.rationale: Mollie exposes webhooks with real-time payment status updates (including failures) and a Subscriptions/Payments API that an agent could poll or subscribe to via the MCP server, giving raw building blocks for monitoring failed payments programmatically. However, there is no documented dunning/retry-management feature, automated retry scheduling, or outreach tooling — an agent would have to build all retry/dunning logic itself on top of raw webhook events and API calls. Missing for 10: native dunning/retry automation, documented failed-payment recovery workflow, and evidence of an agent orchestrating retries end-to-end.
